about_the_game:
Be ready to raise your Superstar up the card! The WWE 2K25 Superstar Mega-Boost includes the MyRISE Boost (200 Attribute Points) + 100,000 VC (delivered in-game on 14 March).

The Superstar Mega-Boost is included as part of the Ringside Pass, as well as WWE 2K25 The Bloodline Editions.
